data.desc: For three decades, FranklinCovey Education, a division of FranklinCovey, and a global leader in education solutions, has been one of the world's most prominent and trusted providers of educational-leadership programs and transformational processes. Its programs, books, and content have been used by thousands of public and private primary, secondary, and post-secondary schools and institutions-including educational service centers and vocational schools-in all 50 U.S. states and more than 70 countries.
